integrity: A structural all-order argument and independent finite semantics enumeration are provided; originality status records comparison with inspected accessible evidence, not independent historical certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for symmetric irreflexive matching attack graphs with at most two edges on a fixed labeled set. Full 2026 motivating paper inaccessible; older equivalent results may exist. Finite computational checks through eight arguments are corroboration, not the infinite proof.
title: Exact static and online learning complexity of two-attack matching frameworks
